THE KNOWN WORLD CARD-KWM · the travel map's design audit · built on Maker 1 10/29/2026 over client v28.22, landed on the Big Mac as client v28.29 (every picture from the landing's own run at HEAD) · for Wyatt and Laura

Wyatt, by phone 10/29 19:16 UTC: "Run a design audit on the current map. Instead of 'See the Territories,' it should say 'The Known World,' and that's all it should really say. The player will just know to click in different areas. The train tracks in the Western Land are currently going over buildings and stuff … Each of the areas needs a little bit of love here to look correct. I'm looking at the HQ, and I see a pumpkin in there, but I don't have a pumpkin out. Looking at the Backyard, it's also looking pretty sloppy, as is the Winter Field. … For now, we'll go with the recommendations pushed to live. Tag in Laura to follow along on this one."

The whole map on his phone (874×402 @3)

The plank says THE KNOWN WORLD and nothing else. Western Land's rails leave the right rim at the hotel, run west along the station's own rail line and curve down to the river trestle; the crossbuck stands at the town's crossing and the compass sits below the rails. The Backyard is at one scale. Every box shows its room's fixtures — no tiny men, no chest toys, no pill on the roof.

Western Land — the rails

Before: the track was laid on 9/5 across an empty desert range; Dylan's town (10/13) then stood under it — the rails ran over the saloon row, the gate, the WANTED bill and the STATION sign, with the crossbuck up on the mesa. After: the rails follow the room's own straight run through the station (room y 470 = map y 396): down the rim past the hotel's east side, across the platform, through the room's crossing, past the sign's post, onto the bottom run at the trestle (the rails sit on its deck to 0.1 unit). Every building clears the 7-unit bed. Under reduced motion the parked train now stands at the station.

HQ — the pumpkin

The pumpkin is THE GIANT PUMPKIN, the Haunted Library MEGA prize. The win puts it on the HQ floor by itself; since Isaac's toy floor (10/26) a floor toy's home in the real HQ is the east floor under the bookcase, beyond a phone's glass unless you pan right — so it never showed in your HQ while the map (which paints the room at its west layout) showed it by the chest. After: the map's boxes show the rooms' fixtures, rides and dogs; the chest's toys stay in the rooms. The duck and the globe left with it. The toys are untouched in the rooms themselves.

The Backyard — one scale, the gate whole

Before: the box painted the room through a cropped viewBox (960×528 into 328×205), so every yard thing stood 13 % taller than wide and the GARDEN gate's top hid under the snowline's mask; four tiny men on the lawn. After: one scale (960×600), the paper and the movers alike — the gate whole, the dinos round, the kickabout where it was, the men out.

The Winter Field

The field is the room shrunk to a third: snowmen, fishers, players, poles, pines, the castle, the gate, the ice caves — and four tiny men. After: the men out. The rest is the room's truth (your 10/2 word: where the snowmen really stand). The Tundra battle on the plain to its left is the map's own (the arena's mark). Laura's Winter Field pass 3 (deeper colour, the glacier gone) will show here the day it lands in the room. The question for Laura below: posters or rooms.

The Rooftop

The SKY FORTRESS pill (a door label) stood in the thumbnail while the fort itself is masked away on the map; four men beside the map's own two. After: the pill and the four men out; the hole, the ladder, the key, the chimney, the two plastic men stay.

The rooms the boxes are pinned to (unchanged)

On WebKit (his engine), the build

The audit, in short

  1. The sign. Three lines of words over the map. → THE KNOWN WORLD alone (CARD-KW's key, already in the seven tongues), a step larger on the plank. The bar is shorter, the map a little taller.
  2. Western Land's rails. The diagonal through the town dates from before the town (the 9/9 second look flagged it: "a moved track is a map redesign"). → The rails take the room's own line through the station. Compass to (1121,425) at r 22; crossbuck to the crossing.
  3. The HQ pumpkin. The MEGA prize, auto-placed on the floor, parked by the toy floor beyond the glass; the map showed it, the room didn't. → The boxes show fixtures, rides and dogs; the chest's toys stay in the rooms. ⚑ KWM-F1: a prize a player can't see without panning is a game finding for a follow-up card.
  4. The Backyard. Stretched 13 % and the gate half hidden. → One scale; the men out.
  5. The Winter Field. Everything at speck size. → The men out; the rest is the room (your 10/2 word). Posters vs rooms is the open design question for Laura.
  6. The Rooftop. A door label in a thumbnail. → Out, with the men.
  7. Nothing owed: the ribbons' seats, the hit zones (proved unchanged), the river, the cove, the stamp, the rim.

A device switch ?kwm=0 shows the map exactly as shipped (the three layers' markup proved byte for byte). The rooms' own paint is untouched (proved base = build, the Western Land paint equal once its clock's values are blanked).
